scope: Follow-up factual-provenance audit of the 127 previously added systems records; original historical research snapshots remain unchanged.
method: Reused prior official-document bodies and retrieval receipts where their content supported the missing claim; independently fetched current application EULAs and price/platform documents for remaining gaps.

For public binary distribution, reviewed the official asset list and checked anonymous HTTP HEAD access to the main application package. Source archives, symbols, unrelated downloads and HTML donation interstitials were excluded as binary evidence.

No installer, command-line application or executable was run, and no package content was downloaded for execution. HEAD metadata establishes accessibility only, not signature, safety, functionality or performance.
Source supports identify exactly which fields have primary evidence. Unestablished pricing and exact application licensing remain unknown, without deleting the application.
The pricing labels for Monitorian and NanaZip were corrected to reflect paid add-ons or editions described by their maintainers.
Web-research receipts are identified separately when the raw shell response is a placeholder. Gzip responses were decoded before document review and document hashing.
No original Windows-PC or cleanup research snapshot, record ID, feature list or use-case list was changed.
